artwork: User-provided forest and open-sky illustration, existing summer manga illustration, and user-selected valley-overlook game artwork. No new image generation or composited scene objects.
processing: Breeze uses the exact user-supplied PNG, fully exported as lossless WebP without cropping or upscaling. Ocean and Night source/export records are retained from v5.

designIntent.ocean: Existing long-haired adult woman in floral swimwear integrated with the beach, ocean and clouds, on the right; seafoam shell, warm-white composer and coral controls. The previous Nami reference is not used.
designIntent.night: User confirmed the mountain valley overlooking scene: mecha on the left, layered valley and clouds on the right. Warm graphite reading panels, copper sunset controls; no independent character layer.
designIntent.breeze: User directly selected this forest illustration: upper-left tree, birds on the right, open blue sky and flowering meadow. Preserve the sage sidebar, milk-white Composer and green controls; no new branding, mascot or layout.
